effective_date_basis: The date in the order, or the end of the committee's authorizing resolution or Congress; otherwise a stated gap.
ending_pattern: The order opens returns to inspection by a named committee or official for an investigation. It ends when the inspection or the investigating body's authority ends, or on a date in its own text.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Information already inspected is an accrued effect.

exemplar.wpa_summary: Inspection of tax returns by State officersfor intangible property tax purposes authorized. [483 ]

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order prescribes general regulations for inspection rather than a single grant.
quoted_clause:
Pursuant to the provisions of section 257(a) of the Revenue Act of 1926 and
section 55 of the Revenue Act of 1928, it is hereby ordered that returns may be open
to inspection by State officers for State intangible property tax purposes, in accord-
ance and upon compliance with the amendment, bearing even date herewith, to the
rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury and approved by
the President, bearing date of April 13, 1926, as amended.

scope.note: Membership is a machine lead; each order is decided by an agent, row by row.

source.custody_limit: Exemplar text is a held copy graded machine_read_government_printed_copy; it illustrates the type's wording and is not an authenticated original.
